description: A GTPE2_COMMON writes the PLL0_CFG and PLL1_CFG it is given, not a fixed 0x1F03DC
exercises: PLL0_CFG and PLL1_CFG of the GTPE2_COMMON in the FASM writer
a reserved wizard attribute away from its default (the PCIe value 0x1F024C)
why: PLL0_CFG and PLL1_CFG are reserved values the transceiver wizard sets; a PCIe design asks 0x1F024C and Vivado writes that. Release 2026-10-15 writes a fixed 0x1F03DC whatever the instance asks, and the same for PLL*_INIT_CFG and PLL*_LOCK_CFG (openXC7/nextpnr#84): the openPCIE x4 build of openXC7/nextpnr#88 differs from its Vivado golden by bits 4, 7 and 8 of both. The design assembles either way.
